briefdescription.para: Apply mode (CPOL/CPHA), midi_cycles (CFG2.MIDI) and clock_speed_hz (CFG1.MBR) if they differ from the last applied values. Safe to call with SPE briefly cleared.

parameterdescription.para: SCK idle cycles between data frames (0–15). See hf_spi_device_config_t::inter_data_idle_cycles for why this is per-device: FIFO-serviced slaves want the pause, shift-register slaves (TLE92466ED) need a continuous 32-bit stream.
Target SCK in Hz; 0 keeps whatever prescaler is already programmed (CubeMX default). See hf_spi_device_config_t::clock_speed_hz.

Optional out-flag: true when CFG1/CFG2 were actually rewritten. Callers use this to decide whether the post-mode CPOL settle is needed — an unchanged peripheral cannot have glitched SCK, so the settle is pure WCET on a same-device repeat frame.

briefdescription.para: Bring-up probe of the shared MISO/SDO net — no scope required.

detaileddescription.para: Retargets miso_port bit miso_pin_pos to a plain input, samples it with the internal pull-up and then the pull-down — first with every soft-CS idle, then with only device selected — and restores the original MODER/PUPDR. A slave that drives SDO overpowers the ~40 kΩ internal pull; a high-Z net simply follows it.

0 if the probe could not run, otherwise bit7 plus: bit0 = CS idle + pull-up reads HIGH, bit1 = CS idle + pull-down reads HIGH, bit2 = device selected + pull-up reads HIGH, bit3 = device selected + pull-down reads HIGH.
Decode: 0x81 idle high-Z and driven LOW when selected — slave is alive and answering zeros. 0x85 high-Z even when selected — slave never drives SDO (unpowered, held in reset, or MISO not landed). 0x80 held LOW with all CS high — short to GND or a peer driving the shared net.

briefdescription.para: One MCU SPI peripheral + its soft-CS device collection.

detaileddescription.para: Applies per-device SPI mode on transfer so soft-CS multi-slave buses (e.g. MAX Mode 0 + TLE Mode 1) work despite a single CubeMX SPI Init block. Transfers are serialized with PlatformMutex via StmSpiBusLock. Opt-in bench register-poke paths must take the same lock.

simplesect.para:
Soft-CS multi-slave contract (this MCU binding):
Stage short payloads through D1 AXI when the caller buffer may sit in external FMC SDRAM (byte-access hazard class shared with StmI2c).
Flush RX FIFO + clear EOT/TXTF before each soft-CS frame (and after HAL errors so the next peer does not see stale bytes).
CS is SoftChipSelectGuard-scoped per frame; software GPIO already exceeds datasheet tCSS — short settle only.
Clear HW NSS-pulse (SSOM) so multi-byte transfers are one continuous stream under the asserted CS line.
